input.contract_name: Janitorial Services – Passenger Terminal and Airport Support Facilities
input.notes: Issued by Ashbury County Regional Airport Authority. Initial term 3 years (Apr 1, 2027 – Mar 31, 2030) + two 1-year renewal options = 5 years max (Sec. 1.3). Climate inferred from Wisconsin; snow and ice removal not included (Sec. 2.10). Terminal (Bldg 1) is ~486,000 gross SF, but only the Exhibit A Service Areas are serviced (A2). Minimum Compensation Policy: $18.40/hr + $3.25/hr health supplement in 2027. Exhibit D minimum posts: 13/11/9 per shift (33/day) + 3-person FIS crew per arrival.
